reviews.t: Not as nice as Bath Roman
reviews.x: This bath salt set is a good value, but it is not as nice as  the Bath Roman brand.  It is still definitely better than the vast majority of US products at similar price points, but  having recently tried Bath Roman muddy white variety, I have to say that Bath Roman is superior.  The fragrance of Bath Roman is much nicer and the overall experience is more pleasurable.

I love these bath salts!!  I had seen them on Youtube and decided to try them.  It is easy to use (although warning - writing is not in English).  Just use one packet per bath and watch as the colored salts spread throughout the water.  I feel so relaxed (and sore muscles feel better) after using these bath salts (compared to others in the past which haven't worked as well).  It doesn't dye my tub - rinse off tub as you normally would after a bath.  My only thing is that since the writing isn't

These are so soothing and smell amazing and make my skin feel soft and smooth without any greasy residue like some bath products. I've tried one clear and 2 milky and so far I think I like the milky ones best but they are both wonderful. There is a lot of fragrance but it doesn't leave a strong smell on your skin after which I like a lot. It's much more for breathing deeply while you soak. Very relaxing, but I like that it won't clash with any lotions or other products I choose to use after. As

I love, love these bath salts. They're very convenient in single-use portions; I even tuck them into my cosmetic bag when I travel so I can use them on vacation. The scent is gently herbal/floral depending on the "flavor." None of them are overly perfum-y, which I appreciate. I've bought many more packages to give as gifts.

reviews.t: Ecstatic that I can buy these on Amazon
reviews.x: I bought these in Japan years ago when I visited. I am so happy that Amazon carried these bath salts. They offer a really sensuous experience in the tub-- the smell, the feel, the color-- ahhhh.

reviews.t: I wanted to love these, but the smells....
reviews.x: I love a relaxing bath in fall and winter, and I purchased these bath salts about six months ago. Some pros are that I like the milky options, they make the bath feel a little more luxurious, and the placebo effect of the milkiness makes me think the salts are actually doing something significant (I dont really think they are, but that's not really the reason I use them anyway). The colors are kind of fun, although the yellow looks a little too similar to dehydrated urine. The huge con for me is

This is kind of a mixed bag for me. I got this as a gift for a friend but saved a few for myself. I liked the scents but you can't really smell it unless the water is moving and before putting it in the water it does have a detergent smell. The coloring doesn't stain the tub so that's a plus. I must be allergic to something in it because my whole body burned and hurt after using it. Dang.

These are great for simple relaxation time. All you do is put it in your bath, get in, and relax. They do not dye your tub, however they do leave a white-ish color on your skin. No big deal though because it goes away over night. I have really sensitive skin, but these didn't make me breakout. The smell is nice and relaxing too.
Love the different scents!!  Exact product my friends brought to my from Japan.  They use it all the time there.  What a great product!!

Despite spending a lot of time in Japan, I had never encountered these hot spring bath salts! However, as we cannot travel right now I find myself missing hot springs a lot and was hoping for something to replicate the experience. This isn't that, exactly, but it's still very nice. I have sensitive skin and many allergies and have had no problem with these. The scent isn't overwhelming, either. It's relaxing and smells nice and makes my skin soft, and doesn't leave any stain or gunk in the tub.

I bought this set for my boyfriend's birthday. It was a repurchase of the original plus a springs salt that he hadn't tried previously. When you received his present he was thrilled. Since it's been an hour bathroom for several months. I've had an opportunity to use it as well and I can honestly say it's wonderful to use. It leaves your skin subtly scented. Softened and generally feeling nourished and refreshed. I highly recommend this for people looking to improve their bathing experience. Sent

reviews.t: These fragrances transport me to Kyoto - aahhhhh! I love these!
reviews.x: I prefer the fragrances of the clear assortment - the mossy one (I think it is the Hakone scent with green coloring) is so lovely - I just want to smell that fragrance all the time. Great quality bath salts with amazing scents that make a relaxing bath a real treat.

Love it. Just wished they tell you the orange box was milky bath the pink is clear...

I have really sensitive skin and these soaks have never bothered me. I take a bath daily in these and they do not stain my tub. There are different smells abd colors but none of them are overpowering. I love these bath soaks!

reviews.t: Milky bath, not bubble bath! Wonderful scents!!! 💕
reviews.x: I’ve added two photos as examples of this milky bath. I love each scent I’ve opened up. Each bath has been calming and just wonderful!! Highly recommend this product if you’re looking for a milky bath, not bubble bath ;)

reviews.t: These bath salts smell so good!
reviews.x: Love these bath salts. The scents are beautiful, and strong enough that the scent lingers on your skin long after the bath. Very relaxing and indulgent.
These smell so good! And hubby loves the “ milky” ones he hates when bath water is clear  wish I could get a double box of the milky ones frankly!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the bath salts as relaxing and soothing, often mentioning soft or silky-feeling water and relief for sore muscles.
Many customers praise the variety of pleasant scents, with several saying the fragrances evoke Japanese hot springs or Kyoto.
Several reviewers note the single-use packets are convenient, especially for travel, and many are repeat buyers or repurchasing the product.
Some reviewers find the fragrance weak or inconsistent, noting it is only noticeable when the water moves or that it has a detergent-like smell before use.
A few reviewers compare the product unfavorably to other brands or note minor drawbacks like a white residue on skin, while still finding it a good value.
